content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-140. - Hearing.
content.summary:
At the time and place appointed for hearing, the council shall hold an assessment
               hearing and shall otherwise proceed, as provided in
section 78-101
.
(Code 1981, § 27-140; Ord. No. 551, § 81, 5-14-1964)
